reactor_type: Picosun Oy Sunale (R100) flow type ALD reactor
evidence: The H2O2 pulse time was adjusted for the TiO2 deposition. The depositions were done at 200 °C with the Picosun Oy Sunale (R100) flow type ALD reactor. In brief, TMA pulses of 0.1 s, followed by 4 s purge, 2 s H2O2, and 4 s purge in combination with Ti(OiPr)4 pulses of 0.5 s, followed by 4 s purge, 2 s H2O2, and 4 s purge were used in the ALD process.
